The stamping test is a true end-to-end: mock-curl release server + `sh install.sh` (plugin/test_install.py:443-487), then _installed_release_version (:409-427) runs the installed binary's --version with all TERMINAL_JAIL_* env stripped and asserts == "terminal-jail 9.9.9", and the output asserts 'checksum OK (terminal_jail-9.9.9-py3-none-any.whl)' before 'stamped release version 9.9.9'. Code: install.sh shebang gate :1443-1455, then the release-only stamp block :1455-1479 — grep -q '^VERSION_DEFAULT=""$' fails closed with exit 1 (:1461-1464), awk -v tj_ver="$TERMINAL_JAIL_RELEASE_VERSION" replaces the empty line (:1471-1474) via tmp_stamped (:1192, trap-cleaned :1195), before chmod/mv install. Release-onlyness verified: LOCAL_WRAPPER starts "" (:481), is set only for checkout installs (:511); the checkout path keeps its own stamp (:1226) so checkout installs never double-stamp. The stamped value is the wheel's version: TERMINAL_JAIL_RELEASE_VERSION derived :16-17, charset-validated at parse time :24-32. Downstream wiring confirmed: bundled wrapper ships VERSION_DEFAULT="" (plugin/terminal_jail/_bundled/terminal-jail:92), VERSION="${TERMINAL_JAIL_VERSION:-${VERSION_DEFAULT}}" (:119), version() echoes it (:277-279), --version dispatch (:509). TJ-GAP-087 contract green in the same file: test_release_mode_requires_opt_in (:915-953, absolute-path invocation from a checkout-less dir) and all 7 test_require_tier_* (:1119-1287) pass in the fresh runs (`7 passed, 103 deselected`, `1 passed`). [resolution 0.59; plugin/test_install.py, install.sh]
